name: Revyl
long_description:
Revyl is the mobile development platform for agents, developers, product, and design. It brings development, build infrastructure, verification, and application intelligence together in one platform, giving teams and agents a shared source of truth for every mobile application.

Teams can build and run mobile applications in the cloud, understand how their applications work, collaborate across functions, and verify changes against the running app. AI agents gain the context and runtime they need to move beyond simply generating code and understand whether their work actually works.

By connecting the people and agents building software to the application itself, Revyl helps teams move faster, collaborate more effectively, and build mobile with confidence.

launches.title: Revyl - Proactive observability
launches.tagline: Automatically catch and triage bugs before they reach production.
launches.body:
# **TL;DR:**

[Revyl](https://www.revyl.ai/) creates resilient end-to-end tests linked to telemetry traces to catch and triage bugs before they reach production.\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zy7yXTomh7M&ab_channel=AnamHira>

# **Problem:**

* E2E tests frequently break due to UI changes
* Finding the root cause of a bug can be extremely time-consuming
* Bugs in production cause revenue loss and erode customer trust
* Testing practices are fragmented across web and mobile

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85015&key=user_uploads/1321343/0b6d5568-fd23-4cd7-8d5f-1feca7fc1d57)

# **Solution:**

Revyl was developed to simplify your QA pipeline. Provide us with your user flows, and we'll handle the rest.

At its core, Revyl uses resilient end-to-end tests connected to telemetry traces to enable companies to catch and triage bugs before they reach production. Revyl supports tests across Web, iOS and Android.

This approach:

1. Catches bugs across your whole tech stack
2. Prevents bugs from reaching production
3. Accelerates triaging by pinpointing UI and/or microservice failures
4. Cuts test maintenance to near zero

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85015&key=user_uploads/1321343/07c6f0c2-6d2f-4cc2-882c-edd303380eb4)

# **Why Us?:**

* [**@Anam Hira**](https://linkedin.com/in/anam-h-5b37a2125): Built [**DragonCrawl**](https://www.uber.com/en-CA/blog/generative-ai-for-high-quality-mobile-testing/), an LLM-based mobile testing framework, while working as a machine learning engineer at Uber. Dragoncrawl saved $25M in 4 months, detecting 11 P0 incidents.
* [**@Landseer Enga**](https://linkedin.com/in/landseerenga): Experienced in growth-stage startups (PM/Engineer), did some web scraping for PE firms.

# **Our Ask:**

1. [**Book a meeting**](https://cal.com/landseer-enga/book-a-demo) or email us at [founders@revyl.ai](mailto:founders@revyl.ai) if you struggle with testing and want to start pushing to prod on Fridays.
2. If you know anyone on QA/Observability teams we would love to talk to them!
